You are a fix worker on the OBE podcast repo. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast - edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, branch, or push; leave changes uncommitted. No skills/MCP/network. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.

CONTEXT (live proof-run evidence, episode 2026-06-10-fred-cho render of 2026-07-23 15:04, all measured): render_angle_switch built a 129-piece hard-cut program (this plan has zero dissolves). The boundary map sidecar (angle_switched.mp4.boundaries.json) claims total edited length 1889.167s, but the FINAL video after cfr_timeline_clean_cmd contains 56634 frames = 1887.800s at 30fps - the final program is 1.367s SHORTER than the map. Audio (1887.880s) and video agree with each other; BOTH disagree with the map, so the transfer gate (which compares audio position against the map) fails with growing pseudo-drift (-156ms at edited 472s, -366ms at 944s) while the actual lip-sync is likely fine. MECHANISM: pieces are rendered CFR-30 video-only, but their CONTAINER durations are not exact frame multiples; the concat DEMUXER offsets each entry by container duration, creating tiny timestamp overlaps at seams; the final clean's fps=30 filter then DROPS ~41 accumulated duplicate-slot frames, shortening the real video while the map was built from pre-clean per-piece ffprobe durations (build_true_boundary_time_map). Three artifacts (video concat timeline, audio atrim spans, boundary map) are derived from DIFFERENT measurements of the same pieces and disagree.

TASK: make per-piece FRAME COUNTS the single source of truth for all three, and make the gate name this failure class.

OWNERSHIP: you own ONLY: server/pipeline/angle_render.py, server/pipeline/video_assembly.py, server/pipeline/media_gates.py, tests/test_angle_render.py, tests/test_media_gates.py. Never modify anything else. Do NOT weaken any gate threshold.

BUILD:
1. In render_angle_switch (angle_render.py): after rendering each piece (segment or bridge), ffprobe its VIDEO FRAME COUNT (ffprobe -count_frames -show_entries stream=nb_read_frames; pieces are short so this is cheap). Define each piece's true duration as nb_frames/30 exactly.
2. Write the concat demuxer list with explicit per-entry duration lines using those exact N/30 values (file X\nduration N/30 pattern), so concat offsets are exact frame multiples and the downstream fps=30 has nothing to drop or duplicate. Keep the final cfr clean pass as-is (it must become a no-op re-time; it stays as a safety net).
3. Build the true-boundary map (build_true_boundary_time_map or its call site) from the SAME frame-count durations - not from float get_duration container reads. The map total MUST equal sum(nb_frames_i)/30 by construction.
4. Feed segment_actual (the audio builder's actual durations) from the SAME frame-count values, so audio atrim spans, video timeline, and map are one arithmetic.
5. Post-render self-check in render_angle_switch: ffprobe the FINAL cleaned program's frame count; if abs(final_frames/30 - map_total) > 1/30, log an ERROR naming 'timeline-map mismatch' with both numbers and return None (fail the render honestly rather than hand downstream a wrong map).
6. In media_gates.validate_transfer (media_gates.py): add a cheap precondition when a time map is provided - if the rendered program's actual video duration differs from the map's total edited length by more than 1 frame (33.4ms), FAIL immediately with a distinct receipt line 'FAIL MAP_PROGRAM_LENGTH_MISMATCH map_total=X program=Y delta_ms=Z' before any anchor measurement, so this class is named instead of surfacing as confusing anchor drift. Threshold 40ms anchor logic stays untouched.

TESTS:
(a) executed timeline-integrity proof (test_angle_render.py): render >=30 short synthetic pieces whose trim points are deliberately NOT frame-aligned (e.g. spans like 1.983s, 2.017s), run the full render_angle_switch path (mock the media QA that needs real content if required, but the ffmpeg concat + clean must actually execute), then assert: final program frame count == sum of per-piece frame counts (no drops), map total == final duration within 1ms, and the boundaries sidecar's last edited_end equals the final ffprobe'd duration within 1ms. This test must FAIL on the current code (state in the summary how you confirmed it - the current code loses frames at seams).
(b) gate precondition (test_media_gates.py): fake a program whose duration differs from the map total by 100ms -> validate_transfer fails with MAP_PROGRAM_LENGTH_MISMATCH before anchors; differing by 10ms -> proceeds to anchors.
(c) all existing tests in the owned test files stay green; update any that asserted the old concat-list format or map derivation and list them in the summary.

HOW TO RUN: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_angle_render.py tests/test_media_gates.py -q -p no:cacheprovider

OUTPUT CONTRACT: uncommitted changes + ./fix-summary.md ('# Fix Summary','## Summary','## Files Changed','## Verification','## Assumptions', <700 words).
